about:
Country Pure Foods is headquartered in Akron, Ohio. The company traces its origins to 1995, when a private equity firm merged two regional portion‑juice businesses, Ohio Pure Foods and Natural Country Farms, to form Country Pure Farms. In 2017 the company partnered with Blue Point Capital Partners LLC.

The company produces a broad line of portioned and multi‑serve juices, plant‑based beverages, and frozen novelties. It operates as a private‑label and co‑pack manufacturer serving foodservice, retail, and co‑pack markets. Through a series of acquisitions — including Ardmore Farms (1998), Vitality (2006), Cal Tex Citrus (2012), Quality Kitchens (2014), Ridgefield’s Brand Corp (2016), and Silver Springs Citrus (2017) — it has expanded production capacity across multiple U.S. facilities.

Its customers span foodservice (including restaurants, healthcare facilities, and K–12 schools), retail channels, and co‑pack partners. The company supplies portioned juice cups, cartons, juice boxes, and frozen products such as SideKicks to these segments.

Country Pure Foods positions itself as the largest supplier of portioned juice to the foodservice industry, emphasizing a broad product and packaging portfolio, national distribution, and a focus on private‑label and co‑pack solutions.
